description.text: The second expansion pack of the ADV series, released on 18 April 2003. It is set in the desert of Hoenn's Route 111 and brings the fossil Pokémon Anorith and Lileep, along with Cacnea, Wynaut and Azurill. The cards are numbered to 53. In English it became EX Sandstorm in September 2003.
